title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Austin College
description: Discover the essential late-night food spots that fuel Austin College students, from on-campus social hubs to 24-hour Sherman staples.

cards.title: The Pouch Club
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Social Hub
cards.notes: Located in the Wright Campus Center, this snack bar serves burgers and quesadillas until 11 PM on weeknights for students using Hopper Dollars.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus late-night dining and recreation spot for Austin College students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pouch Club is open Sunday through Thursday from 4:30 PM to 11:00 PM and Friday through Saturday from 4:30 PM to 10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: The Pouch Club | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday; 10:00 PM Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Whataburger
cards.subtitle: Texas 24-Hour Tradition
cards.notes: A quintessential Texas late-night stop located just north of campus, offering 24-hour drive-thru and dine-in service for honey butter chicken biscuits.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Texas fast-food staple located near the Austin College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Whataburger at 3609 N US Highway 75 in Sherman is open 24 hours for both drive-thru and dine-in service.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 3609 N US HIGHWAY 75 SHERMAN, TX
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for dine-in and drive-thru.

cards.title: IHOP
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Pancake Runs
cards.notes: This 24-hour breakfast spot on Highway 75 is a frequent destination for students seeking pancakes or burgers after late study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour breakfast and diner chain popular for late-night student meals.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP at 2617 N US Hwy 75 in Sherman is open 24 hours every day of the week.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Breakfast in Sherman, TX on 2617 N US Hwy 75

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Drive-Thru
cards.notes: Located on Texoma Parkway, this location serves the student population with drive-thru hours extending until 4 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain for late-night tacos and burritos with extended drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1800 Texoma Parkway is open until 4:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Sherman, TX - 1800 Texoma Parkway
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 4:00 AM on Friday and Saturday; 3:00 AM other nights.

cards.title: Jack in the Box
cards.subtitle: Midnight Munchie Meals
cards.notes: A reliable 24-hour option on Texoma Parkway known for its diverse menu and late-night 'Munchie Meals' available to students.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast-food restaurant offering a wide variety of late-night snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jack in the Box at 2133 Texoma Pkwy is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Order from Jack In The Box in Sherman, Texas

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: Classic 24-Hour Diner
cards.notes: Situated on Highway 75, this diner provides a 24/7 space for students to gather for breakfast platters and coffee at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner chain offering a full menu of breakfast, lunch, and dinner items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Denny's at 2815 North Highway 75 in Sherman is open 24 hours.

cards.title: Casey's
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Pizza and Snacks
cards.notes: A convenient 24-hour stop for students to grab pizza, snacks, or fuel, located just a short drive north from the college campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and pizzeria offering late-night food options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Casey's at 3021 N Highway 75 in Sherman is open 24/7 for pickup and delivery.
cards.source_title: 3021 N Highway 75 - Pizza Delivery and Pickup in Sherman, TX | Casey's

cards.title: QuikTrip
cards.subtitle: Reliable 24-Hour Kitchen
cards.notes: Known for its QT Kitchens, this 24-hour convenience store offers fresh grab-and-go items like pretzels and sandwiches for late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store with a dedicated kitchen for fresh food items.
cards.evidence_claim: The QuikTrip at 2801 Texoma Pkwy in Sherman is open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Store open 24 hours; kitchen hours may vary but typically open until 10 PM.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Fast Food
cards.notes: A standard late-night destination on Texoma Parkway, providing consistent fast-food options for students until 11 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: A familiar fast-food chain providing late-night dining and drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 2217 Texoma Pkwy N is open until 11:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Hopper Store
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Convenience
cards.notes: Located within the Wright Campus Center, this store allows students to use Hopper Dollars for late-night snacks and essentials.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus convenience store for Austin College students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hopper Store is one of the on-campus venues where students can use Hopper Dollars for snacks and late-night dining.
cards.access_notes: Hours typically align with the Wright Campus Center operating schedule.
